passages.question: What is the 2025 standard deduction for a joint return?
passages.excerpt: For 2025, the standard deduction amount has been increased for all filers. The amounts are: ... $31,500-Married filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse.

passages.question: How is the tax figured on taxable income of $100,000 or more for a joint return?
passages.excerpt: Section B-Use if your filing status is Married filing jointly or Qualifying surviving spouse ... At least $100,000 but not over $206,700 x 22% (0.22) ... $10,172.00 ... Over $206,700 but not over $394,600 x 24% (0.24) ... $14,306.00

passages.question: At what rates are qualified dividends taxed on a 2025 joint return?
passages.excerpt: Enter: $48,350 if single or married filing separately, $96,700 if married filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse ... Enter: $533,400 if single, $300,000 if married filing separately, $600,050 if married filing jointly ... Multiply line 17 by 15% (0.15).
